method: Pairwise bbox relation is computed on source bboxes normalized to JGD2011 longitude,latitude. Disjoint-bbox minimum separation is approximated by comparing projected EPSG:6677 boundary segments sampled at 32 segments per edge. Projected axis-aligned envelopes are retained as context only.

interpretation_limit: BBox overlap only. It does not establish that features coincide, share a floor, or connect; it is not routing evidence.

older_vintages.note: This endpoint returns latest catalog entries only; earlier vintages were not enumerated.

mesh_coverage.hold: HOLD: no latest catalogued nominal ubld mesh is among the Hokonavi bbox meshes. Nominal mesh is not actual coverage; older vintages UNKNOWN.
mesh_coverage.note: JIS X 0410 first/second/third mesh calculation; closed bboxes include cells touched at a boundary. File-name mesh is nominal. Actual geometry may extend outside it. No feature correspondence is inferred.
